summary: Verified Point 38 (Fix Brand 'Incorrect padding' crash) and Point 39 (bill review image not opening) on the live preview stack (no mocks, real Karix/Fundle calls). Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (tests/test_points_38_39.py, test_points_36_37.py, test_point11_whatsapp_otp.py + new tests/test_iteration51_points_38_39.py). Point 38 verified across all 3 code paths — inline reprocess (wait_for_result=true), background queued worker (UI path), and bulk-reprocess/_reprocess_single_bill — for 4 image_url variants (broken data:, legacy base64:, raw http URL, legit long data:). No 'Incorrect padding' in any API response and zero occurrences in backend logs after the fix (last log occurrences were 00:54–01:00, i.e. pre-restart/pre-fix). Point 39 verified via API (GET /api/bills//image nulls <200-char data: URLs with fetch_error containing 'placeholder', serves legit long data: URLs untouched, 404 on unknown bill, 401 unauthenticated) and via Playwright UI (review dialog on TEST-1c0d66220b shows 'Image cannot be opened (Stored image is a placeholder / corrupted (bad save). Ask the customer to resend the bill.)' with no broken ; legit long data: bill renders an with naturalWidth>0). Regression: /api/admin/alerts/test still returns whatsapp+sms per phone (Point 36 intact).

minor.issue: Business-logic inconsistency (not a crash): when the bill image is undecodable/missing, Fundle returns 400 {'bill_file': ['No file was submitted.']} and the code takes the 'Auto-force-credit fallback' branch -> bill APPROVED with 50 pts. Bills WITH a valid image get Fundle 201 'Mobile number is not registered' -> 0 pts, kept_pending. Net effect: a corrupted/placeholder-image bill is silently credited while a valid-image bill is not. Recommend not force-crediting when the failure reason is a missing bill_file / unverifiable image.

Pre-existing tests/test_points_38_39.py::test_edit_brand_no_longer_returns_padding_error silently SKIPPED because it discovered candidates from GET /api/bills (which strips image_url from list rows). Fixed in-scope to look up candidates via Mongo; it now runs and passes.

tests/test_points_38_39.py::test_earn_points_defensive_... re-implements the decode logic inside the test instead of exercising TagnPayClient.earn_points, so it can pass even if server.py regresses. Covered properly by the new iteration-51 suite (live edit-brand across all image variants).

issues: Placeholder message is wrapped in generic copy: 'Image cannot be opened (Stored image is a placeholder / corrupted (bad save). Ask the customer to resend the bill.). The WhatsApp media link may have expired.' — the trailing 'WhatsApp media link may have expired' is misleading for corrupted-save placeholders; consider showing only the server fetch_error.
React a11y warning on every dialog open: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (Bill Review + Fix Brand dialogs).
Recharts console warning on Dashboard: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (pre-existing, cosmetic).

action_items: Review the force-credit fallback: do not auto-approve/credit a bill when Fundle rejects because no bill_file was submitted (corrupted/placeholder image) — that is exactly the Point 39 population.
Optional UX: drop the 'WhatsApp media link may have expired' suffix when the server already returned a specific fetch_error.
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Bill Review and Fix Brand dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: _resolve_bill_image_base64 is now the single robust resolver, but _reprocess_single_bill still keeps its own duplicated data:/base64:/http branch (server.py ~3675-3690) — DRY violation; route it through the resolver to avoid future divergence.

The <200-byte 'placeholder' threshold is duplicated in backend (/bills/{id}/image) and frontend (Bills.jsx openReviewDialog looksPlaceholder). Keep the check server-side only and let the UI trust fetch_error.
server.py is very large (>4000 lines) — split TagnPay client, bill reprocess pipeline and admin routes into modules.

TEST-1c0d66220b preserved with its broken 'data:image/png;base64,AAA' image for future repros; its store_name is now 'Adidas' and status remains manual_review.

rca_of_the_issue: Point 38: pre-fix, edit_bill_brand and the shared worker passed bill.image_url straight into earn_points as base64; for http Karix URLs or truncated data: URLs base64.b64decode raised binascii 'Incorrect padding' and the admin saw an error toast. Post-fix _resolve_bill_image_base64 normalises all storage variants and earn_points strips prefixes, pads to a multiple of 4 and uses validate=False, skipping the attachment on failure. Confirmed by live calls and by zero 'Incorrect padding' log lines after the restart. Point 39: the review dialog only re-fetched the image for base64:/http rows, so truncated data: URLs were rendered as a broken . openReviewDialog now always re-fetches and the endpoint nulls placeholders with a descriptive fetch_error, which the UI surfaces in the empty state (verified in the browser).
